name: Mistral Vibe
description: Writes, tests, and refactors code from the terminal or ACP editors, and runs long work tasks over connected tools, for developers and teams on Mistral models.

skills.name: Subagent Delegation
skills.description: Delegates work to independent subagents, such as the read-only explore agent, through the task tool.

skills.name: Programmatic Mode
skills.description: Runs non-interactively with --prompt or piped input for scripts, with optional auto-approval of tool calls.

skills.name: ACP Editor Integration
skills.description: Runs inside VS Code, JetBrains, Zed, and other editors that support the Agent Client Protocol.

skills.name: MCP Servers
skills.description: Connects local or remote MCP servers, with API-key headers or OAuth browser login, to extend its tools.

skills.name: Custom Skills
skills.description: Loads reusable skills from user and project folders, which can also register custom slash commands.
